Transferable mechanic: compromise the conferencing SERVER, then trojanize the client installer it distributes so every org joining a call is backdoored. Priority held at notable, not high, because in-constituency TrueConf deployment is likely minimal and the entry says so.

Build-time credential theft via typosquatted proc-macro1 in three crates incl. arrayref (very widely depended on). Multi-source: Rust Security Response Team primary + StepSecurity + Wiz + RustSec. Continues the supply-chain wave the store tracks.

CERT-PL national-CERT carve-out. Education/research is inside the constituency. Pre-auth login-token forgery + two file-upload RCE paths, END OF LIFE so no fix will ever exist - clears PD-11(b) 'otherwise' limb because the absence of a vendor forces the timeline.

Backlog row unblocked in substance: a cited source now states attacker behaviour (phishing email w/ malicious PDF attachment, opened >1wk before the 14 Aug isolation) so the ATT&CK mapping is evidence-bound, not invented. Vector is Reuters via unnamed Sicherheitskreise = ONE source (two outlets relaying one wire = one source), NOT the government's account, and must be attributed as such. Data-loss claim is genuinely contradicted (Senate: only public open geodata; rbb via govt circles: some highly sensitive) -> report both, pick no side.

SAME GTIG report surfaced by two domains - merge to one entry. Three Russian-nexus clusters (UNC6293, UNC7005/Storm-2945, UNC5976) abusing app-specific passwords, OAuth verification-code sharing and WhatsApp device-linking against European/NATO diplomats, defense personnel, academics. Identity-protocol abuse is explicitly in the audience profile. Reconcile the two agents' technique sets against the primary during deep read.

SPECTRE implant abuses two BYOVD drivers (CVE-2019-16098 Gigabyte, CVE-2021-21551 Dell) to blind CrowdStrike/SentinelOne/Defender kernel callbacks; Talos assesses agentic-AI-assisted exploit development. Resolves the S4->S3 lane-handoff risk: S3 caught it with more depth than S4's deferral implied.

DEEP DIVE. Check Point turns Windows Defender's own boot-time remediation driver (BTR.sys) into a signed, WDAC-immune kernel read/write primitive with NO vulnerability required, Windows 7-11. Squarely the audience's declared fluency (driver abuse, kernel-callback techniques). Deep-dive criterion 3; category windows-lpe absent from the last 30 days so rotation favours it; deep_dives_today=0.

China-nexus actor with established European government targeting.
